name: Letuchij korabl'
source:
This is an interactive story based on Russian fairytale of the same name. The king wished to marry the daughter to the one who will construct the flying ship. But it was constructed by simple rural guy Ivan for whom it is necessary to play. But the king does not wish to give out the daughter for Ivan and starts to think of different riddles. If it will be not gained by friends whom it can find on road there will be a bad end.

[From [url=https://anntenna.itch.io/fly]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部改编自同名俄罗斯童话的互动故事。国王希望把女儿嫁给能够造出飞天船的人。飞天船却由一个名叫伊万的普通乡村青年造了出来，玩家要扮演的正是他。然而，国王不愿把女儿嫁给伊万，于是开始提出各种难题。如果得不到旅途中结识的朋友帮助，故事就会迎来坏结局。

[From [url=https://anntenna.itch.io/fly]itch.io[/url]]
